ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a blue-purple animal cell, with a nucleus and various organelles inside. Outside the whole cell there is a thin and continuous outer boundary line, completely surrounding the cell. Reasoning: The question asks “What surrounds the cell?”, that is, what the structure around the cell is. The outermost boundary structure of an animal cell that surrounds the whole cell is called the plasma membrane.
